Before they come RA said they have to work in a rubber factory near Bangkok and working and living conditions are nicely supported and also they show a picture of the working and living situation. But when they arrived there is a southern part of Thailand. Altogether 25 workers from Mikethila (Mandalay, Myanmar). Now they have to work at the farm, cleaning the farm all day, working in the Ammonia Acid pond without any protection material (just only providing shoes) and the smell is really strong. A group of 5 workers ran away from a Pallet Factory at Chanthaburi, and right now they are working at a construction site.
A couple came to work at Thailand through RA named: Royal Manpower-Cambodia Co., Ltd.Workers want to get the job fast so, they ask the RA to find a job for them quickly, then they both paid around 1,000 $ to the RA. The RA just provided them with the Travel Document without a visa and brought them to cross the border illegally; RA said once the workers arrive the factory the employer will process visa and other document for them. And RA promised them, they will earn more at the factory with regular OT. 

When the workers arrived at the factory, they didn't even have regular work and received only a daily wage of 325 baht/day. The factory communicates with the workers; if they really want to work here for a long time, they need to pay 2,000 - 3,000 baht monthly for them to process the document for them. Workers thought they got paid very little and if the factory deducts the document fee from them; they don't even have enough money to send it home. So, they contact the RA and ask to move to another factory. RA said other workers can do it, why don't they. And when the workers point out why not RA do the Visa for them, the RA responded because the workers themselves want to work fast. It's your fault, don't blame them.  

Therefore, the workers with the other three workers decided to run away and now they are working at the construction site. The workers need a proper job and have sufficient documents to work in Thailand.

call_details.description:
A group of 5 workers ran away from a Pallet Factory at Chanthaburi, and right now they are working at a construction site.
A couple came to work at Thailand through RA named: Royal Manpower-Cambodia Co., Ltd.Workers want to get the job fast so, they ask the RA to find a job for them quickly, then they both paid around 1,000 $ to the RA. The RA just provided them with the Travel Document without a visa and brought them to cross the border illegally; RA said once the workers arrive the factory the employer will process visa and other document for them. And RA promised them, they will earn more at the factory with regular OT. 

When the workers arrived at the factory, they didn't even have regular work and received only a daily wage of 325 baht/day. The factory communicates with the workers; if they really want to work here for a long time, they need to pay 2,000 - 3,000 baht monthly for them to process the document for them. Workers thought they got paid very little and if the factory deducts the document fee from them; they don't even have enough money to send it home. So, they contact the RA and ask to move to another factory. RA said other workers can do it, why don't they. And when the workers point out why not RA do the Visa for them, the RA responded because the workers themselves want to work fast. It's your fault, don't blame them.  

Therefore, the workers with the other three workers decided to run away and now they are working at the construction site. The workers need a proper job and have sufficient documents to work in Thailand. 

As labor attache who are managing the Cambodian RA so, o&e provide the labor attache contact to the workers for them to report the case of RA.
Follow up with the worker: worker still not contact to the labor attache yet.

closed_notes: Issara is closing this case because the business retrained the supervisors and communicated with workers about how they can report any grievances to HR with proper safeguards for workers.
remediation_issara_recommendation:
Context: The workers reported not having secure and responsive grievance mechanism. Workers said that if they have issues with the line supervisors or with the mangers and they report about the issues to the HR, the HR does not take proper actions, instead the  HR informs about the report to the relevant supervisors or the manager which resulted the workers benign targeted by them. There are some supervisors who even said that “even if you report the issue to the HR, don’t expect for the issues to be solved effectively”. There was a case where a worker was heading to the office to report the Issue, unfortunately, the production manager found that and stopped the workers from going to the office. 


The business shall conduct an immediate investigation about the issue. 
The investigation should ensure safeguards are in place and that there is no risk of retaliation. The investigation should be confidential, meaning that workers’ identities should not be exposed in order to mitigate the risks of being targeted. 
The business shall take disciplinary action based on the business policy and the investigation results. 
The business to make a fresh announcement to all workers about the different grievance mechanisms channels they can use to report their issues. The communication about the grievance mechanisms channels should also include information about the process of how the grievances are handled and the confidentiality of such channels. This will give more confidence to the workers to use the business's internal grievance channels. 
The business should clearly communicate with all supervisors and workers the business policy regarding behavior and what are disciplinary actions for those not following the company policy. 

Time Frame; 2 weeks.
remediation_business_steps_taken:
IDENTIFIED POSSIBLE ROOT CAUSES
Inappropriate supervisor attitude resulting in insufficient communication

CORRECTIVE ACTIONS / REMEDY CONFIRMED BY SEAFRESH
1. Re-training the supervisors to know about labor protection laws. forced labor and Good Labor Practices in three sessions of the GLP & Business Ethics course on 21,22 and 23 April 2022.
remediation_notes: The workers reported not having secure and responsive grievance mechanism. Workers said that if they have issues with the line supervisors or managers and report them to HR, HR does not take proper action.  Instead, HR informs the relevant supervisors or the managers about the reports and workers are facing retaliation for having made such reports.  Some supervisors even said, “even if you report the issue to HR, don’t expect the issues to be solved effectively”. There was also a case where a worker was heading to the HR office to report an issue but the production manager stopped him from going to make the report.
remediation_action: The business investigated this matter and found that the supervisors had an inappropriate attitude regarding the right of workers to safe channels to report their grievances.  The business re-trained the supervisors on the labor protection act and good labor practices on 21,22 and 23 April 2022.
remediation_validation: Issara followed up with the worker.  The worker confirmed that the business made an announcement regarding this issue, that all workers could either call the HR office contact number (which was provided to workers) or report any issues directly at the HR office through the interpreter.
remediation_results: Issara is closing this case because the business retrained the supervisors and communicated with workers about how they can report any grievances to HR with proper safeguards for workers.
systems_change_issara_recommendation:
Recommendations for system change

Based on the results of the investigation and the assessment of the business on how the issues were responded to workers' grievances, the business shall provide training to the HR who receive workers cases and shall revise as needed the protocols to respond to workers. Since workers explained that they had reported the issue but nothing was solved but were targeted, the business is recommended to look into the grievance mechanism channels and identify what shall be amended or improved. 
Issara can also provide tailored training with HR and the supervisors.

call_details.description:
Client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai under a free visa and ticket arrangement. The client was promised a basic remuneration of 110 Kd, which she received from her employer. However, she endured severe mistreatment at the hands of her colleagues during her three-month tenure, resulting in physical abuse and visible injuries. Despite her employer's adherence to promised services, the client was repatriated to Nepal after 16 months due to ongoing violence from her colleagues, compounded by her limited language skills and vulnerability as a newcomer. The client now faces significant financial debt, prompting the provision of counseling services to support her during this challenging period.
Key Facts:
1. The client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai on a free visa and ticket, with a promised monthly remuneration of 110 Kd.
2. Her colleagues subjected her to abusive behavior for three months, resulting in physical injuries and visible marks on her body.
3. The client was assaulted on two separate occasions for minor reasons, such as coughing while her colleagues were eating.
4. While the employer fulfilled their obligations and provided the promised services, they recognized the client's vulnerability and repatriated her to Nepal.
5. Due to her limited language skills and unfamiliarity with the country, the client became an easy target for abuse by her colleagues.
6. The client is burdened with substantial debt, necessitating counseling services to address her financial and emotional well-being.

call_details.referral_notes:
This case reported o the US anti-trafficking hotline at 11:00pm, 21 July (last night) and they were going to refer it to local authorities in Los Angeles, who would then contact me for more details. 

Their initial case report took 15 minutes and collected info such as name, age, gender, nationality (btw when I/Lisa said "Lao" she said "what?" and I/Lisa said "Lao" and she/Police said "can you spell that?" and I/Lisa said "L-A-O" and she/Police was like "Huh?" so I/Lisa had to explain "...okay so it's a small country in Southeast Asia" and she/Police was like "OHHHHHH!"), and then some details of the employer - name, age (don't know), gender, address. 

I/Lisa was described the working and payment conditions, and she/Police did not ask any questions about recruitment.  They could not accept any photos or documents, but said that if the police wanted them, they would send me a special secure email address to send files to.

Based on the working conditions and the situation of the final call the brother had with his sister, the case was marked as urgent - so I will keep you posted, and if I don't hear from them within 48 hours I/Police will call back.
call_details.next_steps: This would report to his brother on the stage and process that Issara taken in the US and ask him to wait within 48 hours.

call_details.description:
Name  Mr. Shanti Lal 
Age - Around 40. 
Passport - J 8122700
Work Permit - 10512559011758
Source Country address -  Dehradun province, Anthwal village.
Arrival Date - 6th, June 2016. 
Recruiter - He came to Thailand with a tourist visa and changed to non B. 
Employer - Taj Cafe Indian restaurant. 
Address of the Employer - 1/29-30 Sukhumvit soi 3, Bangko (Near Grace Hotel), Ph- +6622535560. 
Job title and position - Indian Chef. 
 
A helpless Indian victim with several exploitations by the employer. 
 
He came with a tourist visa and his employer applied for a work permit for him. 
Started working there from June 2016 till October 2020. His documents have been retained by the employer since he arrived. He had worked for his employer till October 2020. Since February 2020, the client did not receive wages. He worked there till September 2020 without getting paid (total 8 months of unpaid wages). Since the employer did not give salary for 8 months, the client requested his employer to return his document so that he can find another job. The employer refused to return his documents. That is the reason the client reported to the Indian Embassy and the local police. The local police visited the employer, the employer made his remaining workers lie to the police. It means that the employer and the remaining workers argued to the police that the employer has not retained his documents. Indian Embassy replied to the victim that his employer never picked their calls. In addition to that, one of the female staff of the Indian Embassy told the client that his employer might harm him, he better avoid him. As the victim did not have a job since then, the victim relied on and stayed with one of his friends in Phra Khanong. In the last week of February 2021, the employer contacted him and said that he will return his documents. The employer picked him up from his place of residence and put him in his car but badly physically abused and dropped him on the way at night. After a few days of being beaten, his friend also refused to stay with him.  The victim ended up on the street for one night. Fortunately, with the help of his old colleagues, the client is currently staying in Bearing next to my Soi with the help of myself and my friends from that area. We have rented a small room and have been supporting his living rental fees since the last week of February 2021.
 
The client wants to return back to India. 
 
As he could not get his documents back from the employer, the client approached the embassy and requested to issue out passes (the letter that can allow them to be returned). The embassy suggested the client report to immigration for the repatriation and pay the fine and buy a flight ticket so that the Indian embassy can issue the letter. As the client could not speak the languages, he paid 19000 THB to a broker name Mr. RanVijay Yadav on 17, Dec 2020. The broker has not done anything for him till now. The client has been following up with the broker but the broker lately said that the victim has to buy a flight ticket so that he can report to immigration. The client has no money to buy a ticket. It means that the broker is also cheating the client. 
 
Risk assessment.
The victim said that his employer has connections with the gang stars. He has very high risks so that he does not want to let his employer know about him being in Thailand. He is a working father of three children in India sending money back home when he was earning.

Case Background: Miss. WAN SREYLEAK used to work for Pacific Fish Process Co. Ltd, she left few months ago without informing the business due to the Covid 19 community outbreak in the factory. When she left, she was not dare to ask the business to bring her passport from the business. After she left, she decided to spent 3000 THB to the broker to find another job for her by giving her nation ID card to the broker to process the document. The broker promise to find a good job for her at the electronic factory, but after working for few days, she can’t work in that place due to the difficulty and her physical can’t work with heavy stuff. So she ask the broker to bring her ID back. However, the broker ask for more money if she want her ID back. The broker stated that they spent the money to the ministry for process the document, if worker want her ID she need to pay that fee. 

Case Update based on follow up questions:

**The broker already returned her ID back. 

She start to work at Pacific Fish factory on 07/01/2019 as MoU worker by recruiting and processing from a recruitment agency (she did not remember the agency's name but she does have contact number). She decided to leave the Pacific business on 05/10/2021 due to the Covid outbreak in the factory, but the business asked her not to leave. They asked her to wait until 15-12-21 the date that her MoU will end. The reason why her passport was kept by the business because her she need to deduct her salary for paying back when the business pay all document processing with RA. But she paid all cost since  last year and still the business did not give her the documents. 

She moved to Ayuthya in October by bus when the broker promise to give her job there. In terms of the cost break down she spent about 6000 THB for traveling, 3000 THB for the food and 5,000 to broker for service charge.

Now she is in Samut Prakan working in Plastic factory as undocumented worker with her husband. In terms of the traveling to work the current business accommodate the commute. 

She need her document back from Pacific business. She said that she will contact the RA for asking to talk to the that factory in order to ask to return her document back. Aslo, if possible she would like to ask Issara to talk to the business to have those document back. She want to work her for saving some money and go back to Cambodia.

call_details.description:
Client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai under a free visa and ticket arrangement. The client was promised a basic remuneration of 110 Kd, which she received from her employer. However, she endured severe mistreatment at the hands of her colleagues during her three-month tenure, resulting in physical abuse and visible injuries. Despite her employer's adherence to promised services, the client was repatriated to Nepal after 16 months due to ongoing violence from her colleagues, compounded by her limited language skills and vulnerability as a newcomer. The client now faces significant financial debt, prompting the provision of counseling services to support her during this challenging period.
Key Facts:
1. The client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai on a free visa and ticket, with a promised monthly remuneration of 110 Kd.
2. Her colleagues subjected her to abusive behavior for three months, resulting in physical injuries and visible marks on her body.
3. The client was assaulted on two separate occasions for minor reasons, such as coughing while her colleagues were eating.
4. While the employer fulfilled their obligations and provided the promised services, they recognized the client's vulnerability and repatriated her to Nepal.
5. Due to her limited language skills and unfamiliarity with the country, the client became an easy target for abuse by her colleagues.
6. The client is burdened with substantial debt, necessitating counseling services to address her financial and emotional well-being.

call_details.description:
Wint received the phone call of the job seekers reporting about the cheating case of illegal agency called Ever Smile this morning. These job seekers are from Yay Oo tsp, Sagaing division where no internet access and lack of information. They believed the illegal broker from Ever Smile unofficial agency and paid 17 laks to the broker by individual job seekers. The brokers said them they will send workers on April within two months after signing employment contract. They made the fake employment contract and signed in somewhere from Yangon, not Pin Lone hall. But job seekers did not know that it was a fake. Now it became May and they could not go yet. The broker said they cannot take any responsibilities and you can complaint to anywhere and they donot care. When I asked them over 100 people gave money to that broker 1700000mm kyats each. So, over 170 laks.
So they contacted to issara what they should do. So, I gave them the phone numbers of safe migration of MOLIP, complaint mechanism center of labor ministry and  CTUM phone numbers to make the complaints about their case. And I also told them how to find other legal aid service providers in our GD app too. Are there any suggestions from team members for that case? I said the callers to let issara knows about the updated information too.

call_details.description:
Client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai under a free visa and ticket arrangement. The client was promised a basic remuneration of 110 Kd, which she received from her employer. However, she endured severe mistreatment at the hands of her colleagues during her three-month tenure, resulting in physical abuse and visible injuries. Despite her employer's adherence to promised services, the client was repatriated to Nepal after 16 months due to ongoing violence from her colleagues, compounded by her limited language skills and vulnerability as a newcomer. The client now faces significant financial debt, prompting the provision of counseling services to support her during this challenging period.
Key Facts:
1. The client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai on a free visa and ticket, with a promised monthly remuneration of 110 Kd.
2. Her colleagues subjected her to abusive behavior for three months, resulting in physical injuries and visible marks on her body.
3. The client was assaulted on two separate occasions for minor reasons, such as coughing while her colleagues were eating.
4. While the employer fulfilled their obligations and provided the promised services, they recognized the client's vulnerability and repatriated her to Nepal.
5. Due to her limited language skills and unfamiliarity with the country, the client became an easy target for abuse by her colleagues.
6. The client is burdened with substantial debt, necessitating counseling services to address her financial and emotional well-being.
As client was undocumented we could not take any other action but the client was provided with legal counseling

Issue: At the workplace while his brother is working, a supervisor (Meka) comes toward and dragged him that caused his brother's necklace to break into pieces. He tried to ask the employer to find justice for his brother but the employer doesn't seem to care because he doesn't want to disappoint the supervisor as the supervisor earned a lot for him. The client did not want to continue the case because he thought that this case might risk his life.

Client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai under a free visa and ticket arrangement. The client was promised a basic remuneration of 110 Kd, which she received from her employer. However, she endured severe mistreatment at the hands of her colleagues during her three-month tenure, resulting in physical abuse and visible injuries. Despite her employer's adherence to promised services, the client was repatriated to Nepal after 16 months due to ongoing violence from her colleagues, compounded by her limited language skills and vulnerability as a newcomer. The client now faces significant financial debt, prompting the provision of counseling services to support her during this challenging period.
Key Facts:
1. The client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai on a free visa and ticket, with a promised monthly remuneration of 110 Kd.
2. Her colleagues subjected her to abusive behavior for three months, resulting in physical injuries and visible marks on her body.
3. The client was assaulted on two separate occasions for minor reasons, such as coughing while her colleagues were eating.
4. While the employer fulfilled their obligations and provided the promised services, they recognized the client's vulnerability and repatriated her to Nepal.
5. Due to her limited language skills and unfamiliarity with the country, the client became an easy target for abuse by her colleagues.
6. The client is burdened with substantial debt, necessitating counseling services to address her financial and emotional well-being.
As client was undocumented we could not take any other action but the client was provided with legal counseling

description: Unsafe or hazardous working conditions (OSH issues)

call_details.description:
Shrimp breaking line 
The caller reported that the worker from KOTO faced toilet problem and workers personal phone and money were stolen from their accommodation because the employer does not allow the worker to bring mobile and money with them at workplaces. He said the worker from KOTO does not receive labour rights such as not enough toilet, limited time to take toilet within 15 minutes. The worker had reported the toilet issue to the line supervisor and employer many times but they do not repair it unstill now. There is about 20 toilets room and only 2 of them are working and the worker from the housing have to get into the line for taking the toilet so it is a big problem for them he said. When workers took toilet at the workplace the line supervisor also shouted to them.  
The employer said if you see someone stole your property you can take his picture who is stolen and you all can lock the door etc. The worker said when ISSARA visiting at KOTO the line supervisor had threatened the worker and said who report the issue to ISSARA he/she will be dismissed immediately.
The caller would like ISSARA to help them to solve the toilet problem and some labour rights issue (worker doesn’t mention what kind of labout rights, O&E will follow up more info) 
.

Informant being targeted
This informant is the daughter of ex-informant who left KOTO already. She said that her mother was targeted by Akar, the bad translator, for being an informant to Issara. That’s why she has a huge concern being an informant to us. She doesn’t want to end up with the situation like her mother did. This is one of the main reasons Issara has not been receiving as much worker voice as it should. It would be great if Business must ensure the safe guard for the worker is one of the COCs required by the Buyer. 
Sick Leave
Workers are being barred from getting OT for 6 days, if they take sick leave. For example: a worker gets sick during work. And she meets the nurse at the clinic inside the factory compound. The worker would be asked to stop doing OT for a week. For the workers who take sick leave a day or two also would be asked to stop doing OT for a week. It would be great if KOTO can clarify how OTs are being provided to the workers. 
Foul smell
Workers are unable to sleep well due to the foul smell from the sewage pools near the housing. It smells worse when receiving raw shrimps. Closing all the windows and doors doesn’t help. Issara team had such experience, getting the foul smell, during the housing visit last year. 
Clinic
Workers claim that the clinic provide the same medicine most of the time. A worker, patient, wanted to measure blood pressure to check if the blood pressure is normal. The patient doesn’t know how to speak Thai. So he pointed his finger to sphygmomanometer, hoping the nurse would understand what he wants her to do. Unfortunately, the nurse couldn’t understand what he was trying to say. And he left the clinic without knowing her blood pressure. Although there is a translated chart for basic sickness, the clinic still need an interpreter to provide comprehensive service to the patients. 
 
Housings
This is an old issue which has not been solved yet. Some workers went back to Myanmar as they are not comfortable with the current housing arrangement. 4 to 8 workers, including married couples, sharing the same room while it is not the case for Thai workers. Workers have to pay for water and electric city bill. Both Thai and Myanmar workers don’t have to pay for the room. The informant said, Akar, the translator is sharing his room with his wife only. Even Akar’s brother is allowed to share the room with his wife. KOTO may want to clarify the housing arrangement for both Thai and Myanmar workers without discrimination across the two nationalities, the translator and his brother. 
Visitor regulation
Workers also want to know more about receiving visitors. The informant heard that Arkar asks for money from some visitors. It’s not clear why and how much he asks for money. KOTO might want to investigate the case if they are willing.

closed_notes: Issara is closing this issue.  The worker has confirmed receiving the electricity and water bills and so are able to see what they are being charged for those costs.
remediation_issara_recommendation:
Cambodian workers reported that for the past three months, they have not been receiving the separate monthly bill for their electricity and water use in their dorms, which is deducted from their pay.  This deduction is not stated in their monthly pay slips either.  Therefore, they don't know how much they are being charged for the utility bill each month.  They only see the final amount they are paid after the deductions.

TPs:
-Why has ITC discontinued the practice of providing the electricity and water bill each month so that they can know how much they are being charged for this?
-Why is this deduction not stated clearly in the pay slip?

Recommendations for remediation:
-ITC should be transparent with the deductions for the workers' pay, and resume the practice of providing the monthly bills for the electricity and water charges.
-ITC to communicate with workers about this might have been provided to them for the past three months, and when they will resume providing these bills so that workers know how much they are being charged each month.
remediation_business_steps_taken:
All bills were given to the HR representative in the dorm by HR. And the representative should distribute them to the workers. However, HR will conduct the following investigation.
Did all representatives receive the bills?
Did the representatives present all of the bills to the workers? If not, HR will ensure that all bills are distributed to the workers.

Investigate Case:
Because some dormitory representatives did not come to receive the slips as well as the bill for dormitory maintenance and electricity bills distributed to the workers, causing the worker didn't receive the complete slips.

Solution:
HR assigned the interpreter to follow up and make an appointment for the dormitory representative who did not receive the slip to distribute to the workers and informed the time that must be delivered to workers within the payroll period. In the near future, HR is coordinating with programmers to adjust and develop wage slips to be able to specify the cost of maintenance, water, and electricity costs in each payslip so that they can be viewed with salary slips.
remediation_notes: Cambodian workers reported that for the past three months, they have not been receiving the separate monthly bill for their electricity and water use in their dorms, which is deducted from their pay. remediation_action: The business investigated and found that because some dormitory representatives did not come to receive the pay slips as well as the bill for dormitory maintenance and electricity bills distributed to the workers, some workers didn't receive the bills. remediation_validation: Issara updated the worker about the business action and that all bills were given to the dorm representatives by HR. And the representative should distribute them to the workers. The worker confirmed that she has now received the bill.

call_details.description:
On the July 9th night shift, the production line's PJ-5 workers made the mistake of putting a small piece of paper in the packaging of pet food, and QC found it out.

On the July 10th night shift, the HR office called all the workers from PJ-5 and asked three workers who put the packages into a small box to sign a warning letter admitting that this would not happen again in the future. The three workers accepted their mistakes and agreed to sign. Other workers who worked on brand tags and packaging big boxes were not asked to sign.

After they all came back to the workplace, the line supervisor, who wears a green hat, asked another two workers who work on brand tags to sign the warning letter, too. When the workers asked why they were asked to sign, the head of line supervisors, who wear blue huts, also asked these two workers to sign the warning letters. The workers were told that they could raise the issues at any place if they didn't agree to sign. The workers felt that they were forced to sign the warning letter without making any mistakes by the line supervisors.

The workers asked Issara to inform the HR office and SEAPAC management about the power abuse by line supervisors on the workers and to cancel their signatures on the warning letters because they had to sign them by force.
KPI 126: The worker updated that there is no investigation and no one from HR reached out to her during these weeks. The warning letter she had to sign has not been withdrawn yet.

remediation_issara_recommendation:
A worker reported that in the day shift at the T-6 line of the new building, she requested her line leader (blue-cap) to sign for her to get two new gloves (there are two types of gloves for different tasks, one for cleaning gloves and the other for chicken cutting) because both were old and can't be used any longer. But the line leader neglected her request and told her to get approval when the chief line leader comes. Actually the workers don't need to wait for the chief line supervisor who usually come at 8 am to get approval and Kathy Aung can approve this to get the gloves in time. So the worker went to the office and report this to Ma Dar (Office Translator) and came back to the production line. Around 2:30pm, the line leader yelled at her saying "How dare you report me to the office , don't you know your position and mine are different, that my position is higher then yours. And I don't care about you at all and you can report it to the office or Issara I don't F***king care. I really want top slap your face because your face shows no dignity nor grace. In this condition, Kyi Kyi feels so shy and feel very sorry. So she asked Issara for help.

Recommendations:
- Investigate the matter, identify the root cause of the issue. 
- Communicate the proper procedures for requesting and approving equipment replacements, so that line leaders and workers understand the procedures correctly.
- Ensure that there is clear communication regarding the non-retaliation policy anytime workers report grievances.
remediation_notes: Workers reported that they requested her gloves to be replaced but the line leader ignored it saying the worker should wait for the chief line supervisor. However, workers know that the line leaders have the authority to approve protective equipment replacements so they went to report this to HR. The line leader later yelled and cursed at the workers, and questioned why they had reported her to HR.
remediation_action: HR contacted Issara about this case and explained that they were aware of this case because the worker had come to report it to the HR interpreter. HR investigated by interviewing production line workers and reviewing the CCTV footage. HR discovered that the line leader had verbally abused the worker but then the worker had also chased the line leader and verbally abused her. So, they will both receive a written warning. Line leaders and workers will be trained on how to communicate professionally and also refresh the procedure for requesting glove replacements.
systems_change_issara_recommendation: - Review the grievance mechanism and to ensure there is no suppression of the mechanism and no retaliation against those using the grievance mechansim

call_details.description:
Target amount: The workers have to complete the target amount 32 baskets.
Only people who have been there 7-10 years can complete it. In some lines, shrimp distribution is fair. Sometimes, if there are many people at shrimp peeling line, your supervisor will ask you to go and help another line (arranging shrimp) which have less worker, but when you go to another line, supervisor from another line will ask you: what are you doing here? And when you cannot say anything and go back to your original work station, other supervisor will found you are going around in the room without working then you got scolded again. There are 13 supervisors, so that the worker could not know which supervisor they are interacting with. 
Water flow system: Actually, you can turn on the water to flow automatically but the supervisor do not allow you to let the water flow all the time, so that you have to use one hand to press water and another hand to hold the shrimp. You also need to take care the shrimp not to fall. The room was very cold and the water is also very cold so that most of the worker cannot work there. If the worker shirt gets wet, they are not allowing to change it.
Working hour and Shift schedule: The working time still unstable and the worker have to stand by anytime they are calling if the shrimp arrived. Sometimes, the worker doesn’t have enough rest period especially, on the day that they have extra cleaning duty (2.5 hours). Normally, if you don’t complete the target amount, you cannot work for OT. However, if it is on the cleaning day, you don’t want to work OT because it will be too late, but you cannot refuse it because the cleaning to be done after the shift (8 hours + OT + 2.5 hours cleaning). In the next day, if you have to work on early shift, it is hard for the worker. Sometimes, if the line run out of shrimp/raw materials, the workers have to take meal break just after started working in 1 hour then take a meal break 1 hour and continue another 7 hours without break. So the worker got hungry and it is very hard to work in a very cold room 7 hours consecutively. The workers prefer a fixed work schedule if it is day or night. When the work schedule is changing every day, they could not manage their sleeping time and eating time so that it will affect their health. The roommates are also working in a different schedule so that you cannot have a proper rest in the housing, other people will cook and shower while you are sleeping and there is not quiet time within 24 hours. There are about 8-12 people in a room. The factory gives the reason that the working hour have to manage based on the arrival of shrimp: the workers feel that the factory does not value the human as much as they value the shrimp.  
No rights to refuse OT: It was very cold so that some of the workers don’t want to do OT but they cannot refuse it.
Dormitory: For female (single)dormitory, there is no enough bath room, no enough electric plug to cook. The worker were told that they cannot take shower more than 5 mins. Some bathroom and toilet lock are broken so that you cannot close the door. In some bed room the fan is broken but cannot ask for replacement. They complain it but nothing improved. The mattress are very old and there are bugs in it so the worker request to move it away but they were told that they cannot remove it because it will be a problem if the visitor found it. 
Electric cost: There is no clear system for electric bill. The worker got deduct the bills less if they earned less wages, and they got deduct more if they earn more.
Health care and sick leave: In order to take a sick leave, you need approval from factory clinic nurse, it is not easy. Sometimes, they will tell you to come back again for signature. It is not easy for the workers to find them again and again since the worker have to run from work. Sometimes, the worker got sick and go to see the nurse: if there is no interpreter at the nurse room, you have to wait for a long hour. The workers could not identify which nurse has bad behavior. They thought that all nurses behavior are the same. 
If you take sick leave and went to the hospital and come back with the medical certificate, you got pay only for a half day. The workers are told that they can still work for a half day.

Unfair start-finish working hour calculation, the worker have to get ready and enter to the production line earlier, new restriction of fine for dropping shrimp or if the damaged/unqualified shrimp  1 shrim/2baht to be duducted, grievance mechanism is not properly handle the issue raised.

closed_notes: It was good because the business did an immediate investigation and took action by providing 2 more fans to reduce the room temperature. And the workers also confirmed that they are having better working condition now.
remediation_issara_recommendation:
Context: The issue at the meat grinding machine and the temperature that workers reported was being increased by the line supervisor in order to complete the target faster. 

Issara recommendations. 

-The supplier clearly clarifies the temperature of the grinding machine, rules and regulations for this matter and the grinding machine has a notice attached stating the required operating temperature.
-Supplier to make sure that the H&S officer schedule includes a spot check of the grinding machine temperature on a regular basis
-Supplier to make sure that there is a clear system for workers to report changing of machine temperature by any person, and that there are clear disciplinary consequences attached. 
-The supplier to clearly communicate the policy to the workers.


According to the ETI Base Code on “Working conditions are safe and hygienic, the business should be ensured to all workers that their jobs will not cause to the unsafe and the hazardous condition to the workers.
remediation_business_steps_taken:
The business did an investigation and found that the temperature of the machine can not be increased by the line supervisor because it is regulated automatically. remediation_issara_recommendation:
Kyi Kyi is a worker from F Food-6 working line (new building) and she is currently working on a day shift. According to Kyi Kyi, there are 26-28 workers in her working line. Some days approximately 13-15 workers of F Food-6 have to work in the store room. When it comes to OT allocation, almost all of the workers got OT except 3 workers including herself. On the day, the 13-15 workers have to go to the store room and get a minimum of 3.5 hours OT. Those who remain in the original line ( approximately 10-11 workers) often get OT like 3 hours of OT. However, she and her two friends seldom got OT. On a weekly basis, she and her 2 friends got maximum 6 hours of OT in a week while others got minimum 18 hours of OT. Kyi Kyi added that there are two main people who manipulate ( may be discriminated against) 3 workers in terms of allocation OT. They are her line-supervisor Ms.Pho and her line-leader Kay Thi Aung. These line-supervisor and line-leaders hate Kyi Kyi for contacting Issara and mobilizing workers for Issara training and they hate the other two workers for not buttering them up. So they don't give these 3 workers OT opportunity as much as they gave to other line-workers. When it comes to the assigned job, Kyi Kyi always assigned for heavy tasks ( even in the time she just came back from her maternity leave) such as; washing big tray and putting the heavy tray onto the cart of shelf. And the line-leader Kay Thi Aung is always complained about her performance and find her fault.

TPs:
- How does the business assign OT hours?  Is it equally offered for all workers?  Or is there a system for selecting some workers to work OT?  If so, what criteria is this based on?
- How does the business communicate the OT system to workers?  Currently, some workers don't understand why some are offered more OT and others are offered less.
- Is there a maximum number of hours per week that the business' customers require (such as 60 hours max per week)?  It seems some workers are getting OT hours exceeding the weekly ceiling while others are getting much less  

Recommendations:
- Offering OT hours to workers should be seen as fair.  If there is certain method of offering OT hours to some workers and not others (such as based on performance), this should be fair and clearly communicated to workers
- Maximum number of OT hours per week should be as per customer requirements, and this should be communicated clearly to workers

A couple came to work at Thailand through RA named: Royal Manpower-Cambodia Co., Ltd.Workers want to get the job fast so, they ask the RA to find a job for them quickly, then they both paid around 1,000 $ to the RA. The RA just provided them with the Travel Document without a visa and brought them to cross the border illegally; RA said once the workers arrive the factory the employer will process visa and other document for them. And RA promised them, they will earn more at the factory with regular OT. 

When the workers arrived at the factory, they didn't even have regular work and received only a daily wage of 325 baht/day. The factory communicates with the workers; if they really want to work here for a long time, they need to pay 2,000 - 3,000 baht monthly for them to process the document for them. Workers thought they got paid very little and if the factory deducts the document fee from them; they don't even have enough money to send it home. So, they contact the RA and ask to move to another factory. RA said other workers can do it, why don't they. And when the workers point out why not RA do the Visa for them, the RA responded because the workers themselves want to work fast. It's your fault, don't blame them.  

Therefore, the workers with the other three workers decided to run away and now they are working at the construction site. The workers need a proper job and have sufficient documents to work in Thailand.

call_details.description:
Target amount: The workers have to complete the target amount 32 baskets.
Only people who have been there 7-10 years can complete it. In some lines, shrimp distribution is fair. Sometimes, if there are many people at shrimp peeling line, your supervisor will ask you to go and help another line (arranging shrimp) which have less worker, but when you go to another line, supervisor from another line will ask you: what are you doing here? And when you cannot say anything and go back to your original work station, other supervisor will found you are going around in the room without working then you got scolded again. There are 13 supervisors, so that the worker could not know which supervisor they are interacting with. 
Water flow system: Actually, you can turn on the water to flow automatically but the supervisor do not allow you to let the water flow all the time, so that you have to use one hand to press water and another hand to hold the shrimp. You also need to take care the shrimp not to fall. The room was very cold and the water is also very cold so that most of the worker cannot work there. If the worker shirt gets wet, they are not allowing to change it.
Working hour and Shift schedule: The working time still unstable and the worker have to stand by anytime they are calling if the shrimp arrived. Sometimes, the worker doesn’t have enough rest period especially, on the day that they have extra cleaning duty (2.5 hours). Normally, if you don’t complete the target amount, you cannot work for OT. However, if it is on the cleaning day, you don’t want to work OT because it will be too late, but you cannot refuse it because the cleaning to be done after the shift (8 hours + OT + 2.5 hours cleaning). In the next day, if you have to work on early shift, it is hard for the worker. Sometimes, if the line run out of shrimp/raw materials, the workers have to take meal break just after started working in 1 hour then take a meal break 1 hour and continue another 7 hours without break. So the worker got hungry and it is very hard to work in a very cold room 7 hours consecutively. The workers prefer a fixed work schedule if it is day or night. When the work schedule is changing every day, they could not manage their sleeping time and eating time so that it will affect their health. The roommates are also working in a different schedule so that you cannot have a proper rest in the housing, other people will cook and shower while you are sleeping and there is not quiet time within 24 hours. There are about 8-12 people in a room. The factory gives the reason that the working hour have to manage based on the arrival of shrimp: the workers feel that the factory does not value the human as much as they value the shrimp.  
No rights to refuse OT: It was very cold so that some of the workers don’t want to do OT but they cannot refuse it.
Dormitory: For female (single)dormitory, there is no enough bath room, no enough electric plug to cook. The worker were told that they cannot take shower more than 5 mins. Some bathroom and toilet lock are broken so that you cannot close the door. In some bed room the fan is broken but cannot ask for replacement. They complain it but nothing improved. The mattress are very old and there are bugs in it so the worker request to move it away but they were told that they cannot remove it because it will be a problem if the visitor found it. 
Electric cost: There is no clear system for electric bill. The worker got deduct the bills less if they earned less wages, and they got deduct more if they earn more.
Health care and sick leave: In order to take a sick leave, you need approval from factory clinic nurse, it is not easy. Sometimes, they will tell you to come back again for signature. It is not easy for the workers to find them again and again since the worker have to run from work. Sometimes, the worker got sick and go to see the nurse: if there is no interpreter at the nurse room, you have to wait for a long hour. The workers could not identify which nurse has bad behavior. They thought that all nurses behavior are the same. 
If you take sick leave and went to the hospital and come back with the medical certificate, you got pay only for a half day. The workers are told that they can still work for a half day.

The workers have to complete the target amount 320 coins in 8 working hours. Many workers cannot complete it. If the workers cannot complete the target, they have to sign warning at the Pujakan’s office, and they were told that they will be sent back to Myanmar. Building 3 Pujakan is good but Building 4 Pujakan is bad. 
They count the target amount in coins (arranging shrimp), it is not fair. However, if there are a lot of people in the line, you cannot get enough shrimp so you have to rush for getting shrimp. Sometime, there is no coins included in the shrimp basket, and when you complain about it , supervisor will scold the workers. When they collect the basket and record your target: if you say, I have done 3 baskets without coins, they will not record it as you said. They record whatever they want. The supervisor said they do not have enough coins at the moment, they will have it enough after April then, if the worker could not complete the target amount, they will be sent back Myanmar. 
The working time still unstable and the worker have to stand by anytime they are calling if the shrimp arrived. When the work schedule is changing every day, they could not manage their sleeping time and eating time so that it will affect their health. The roommates are also working in a different schedule so that you cannot have a proper rest in the housing, other people will cook and shower while you are sleeping and there is not quiet time within 24 hours.
The dormitory of building number 5 is new and good maintenance since visitor can see very often. Electric plug for cooking is not enough but since workers have different shift, they can manage rotation for cooking. The interpreter in nurse room shouted the workers. If you take sick leave without medical certificate, you cannot get daily wage. 
For the annual bonus, you will be able to get it only if do not take any single leave.

If the worker requests leave in advanced, the supervisor do not approve it. So, the worker just took it as they need it then supervisor will scold them. If worker takes leave many days, then ask to sign warning at the office. Building 2, supervisor is bad, you cannot refuse to do OT. If your clothes get wet and you are not allowed to change it. Shift schedule is keep changing and it was very cold in this building. The worker plan to resign if she cannot move back to original work line (boiling shrimp line). The worker moved to building 4 (shrimp peeling line) in November 2017 and was told that she will be able to move back to previous line after Songkran.

The worker is from Seafresh and she was followed up to dig the workers issues in factory. 
- To know the sick leave without medical certificate
- To know the shift changed on 2 July.

call_details.description: This call is to one of the 25 clients in ILM ID- 50387. In this call Chit Soe Oo to follow up the latest situation of the case, Chit Soe Oo said they had already asked for a cancellation letter from the employer to move another job. Issara suggested them to ask the cancellation letter from employer via agency and keep working in the work-place until the agency or employer give the job changeable cancellation letter. And told them that we will try to contact MOEAF and agency as soon as possible.

The workers arrived at the construction site in Chumburi on November 23 after they were recruited by Lucky Employment Agency. When they arrived, the workers had to buy the PPE, such as boots, a helmet, etc., by themselves. On the first working day, the employer announced that the workers had to work Sunday with their regular daily wage. If the employer cannot provide a job, the workers won't be paid. The working hours are from 7:00 to 17:30 p.m., which is totally against the contract.

So, the workers contacted the Myanmar RA, raising the issues. The Myanmar RA asked the Thai RA, AAA, to come and solve the issues.

On the day the Thai RA came to them, the workers were asked to follow the employer's announcement. The workers' problems were not solved at all.

The employer would not allow them to stay at their construction site if they did not work as assigned. The Thai RA will rent a room for them, and they have to wait a few months without having jobs to get the cancellation letter.
The workers do not have enough money to stay without jobs.

As a result, the workers contacted Issara and received advice on what they should do. It was suggested that they contact the labor attaché and raise the issues.

The workers did not work in construction, and different workers tried to find new jobs. The six workers, including the client, did not look for any other jobs. They just waited for the job arranged by the Thai RA. 

Later, they were recruited by an employer from Samut Sakhon to work at the sticker factory. The client said they were lucky and are now working with that new employer. She thanks Issara for calling her back and asking about her condition.

The business explained how the chemicals are handled and that they are not harmful for the pregnant workers and their babies. The workers also confirmed not having this issue anymore.
remediation_issara_recommendation:
Pregnant workers have the right to be managed fairly and provided with non-hazardous working conditions, according to a fair and transparent code of conduct, and within the allowances of Thai labour law. 

Pregnant workers should not be asked to handle any products that might affect their health or their baby's health. They should be provided adequate PPE. 

The business should find adequate tasks for pregnant workers and workers with disabilities.  

(timeline: 1 to 2 business days)

Recommendations for system change includes the information that the business should provide to the workers about the cleaning products that are being used.
remediation_business_steps_taken:
20/5/2020 
The business claimed that the chemical the workers are using is required by the buyers and the pregnant workers are not allowed to mix them. There are different workers who have to mixt this chemical to be ready to use. Only then, the pregnant workers have to use them to clean the surface. The business said that the chemical is not harmful to the workers and their baby. The business added that every worker who is assigned to do this task get training prior they start the job. However, the business agreed to conduct communication with all of the involved workers and provided training. 

14/07/2020 

The main client who has reported this issue confirmed receiving training and seeing the improvement. The other workers said that they have not heard of this issue.
systems_change_issara_recommendation:
The business should have a clear policy and description of the tasks for pregnant workers that takes into account workers health and Thai labour law. In addition, the business should provide appropriate PPE and provide clear information to workers about the materials being used and guarantee that they are not hazardous to workers health. 

(timeframe: one payment period)
systems_change_business_steps_taken: The business provided training and communications to all involved staffs

Client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai under a free visa and ticket arrangement. The client was promised a basic remuneration of 110 Kd, which she received from her employer. However, she endured severe mistreatment at the hands of her colleagues during her three-month tenure, resulting in physical abuse and visible injuries. Despite her employer's adherence to promised services, the client was repatriated to Nepal after 16 months due to ongoing violence from her colleagues, compounded by her limited language skills and vulnerability as a newcomer. The client now faces significant financial debt, prompting the provision of counseling services to support her during this challenging period.
Key Facts:
1. The client traveled to Kuwait via Dubai on a free visa and ticket, with a promised monthly remuneration of 110 Kd.
2. Her colleagues subjected her to abusive behavior for three months, resulting in physical injuries and visible marks on her body.
3. The client was assaulted on two separate occasions for minor reasons, such as coughing while her colleagues were eating.
4. While the employer fulfilled their obligations and provided the promised services, they recognized the client's vulnerability and repatriated her to Nepal.
5. Due to her limited language skills and unfamiliarity with the country, the client became an easy target for abuse by her colleagues.
6. The client is burdened with substantial debt, necessitating counseling services to address her financial and emotional well-being.

Last Thursday, 2 girls (Purpule passport holders) had to beg Arkar to help them with visa extension. Arkar told the girls that they should go by themselves for visa extension. The girls said, “We don’t know where to go and how to do it. We just know the market place around this area.” The girls pleaded him to accompany and help them with the extension. Arkar said “Your friend reports bad about me to Issara. I am not going to help you two.” Having no choice, the two girls begged him till he helped them eventually.

Informant being targeted
This informant is the daughter of ex-informant who left KOTO already. She said that her mother was targeted by Akar, the bad translator, for being an informant to Issara. That’s why she has a huge concern being an informant to us. She doesn’t want to end up with the situation like her mother did. This is one of the main reasons Issara has not been receiving as much worker voice as it should. It would be great if Business must ensure the safe guard for the worker is one of the COCs required by the Buyer. 
Sick Leave
Workers are being barred from getting OT for 6 days, if they take sick leave. For example: a worker gets sick during work. And she meets the nurse at the clinic inside the factory compound. The worker would be asked to stop doing OT for a week. For the workers who take sick leave a day or two also would be asked to stop doing OT for a week. It would be great if KOTO can clarify how OTs are being provided to the workers. 
Foul smell
Workers are unable to sleep well due to the foul smell from the sewage pools near the housing. It smells worse when receiving raw shrimps. Closing all the windows and doors doesn’t help. Issara team had such experience, getting the foul smell, during the housing visit last year. 
Clinic
Workers claim that the clinic provide the same medicine most of the time. A worker, patient, wanted to measure blood pressure to check if the blood pressure is normal. The patient doesn’t know how to speak Thai. So he pointed his finger to sphygmomanometer, hoping the nurse would understand what he wants her to do. Unfortunately, the nurse couldn’t understand what he was trying to say. And he left the clinic without knowing her blood pressure. Although there is a translated chart for basic sickness, the clinic still need an interpreter to provide comprehensive service to the patients. 
 
Housings
This is an old issue which has not been solved yet. Some workers went back to Myanmar as they are not comfortable with the current housing arrangement. 4 to 8 workers, including married couples, sharing the same room while it is not the case for Thai workers. Workers have to pay for water and electric city bill. Both Thai and Myanmar workers don’t have to pay for the room. The informant said, Akar, the translator is sharing his room with his wife only. Even Akar’s brother is allowed to share the room with his wife. KOTO may want to clarify the housing arrangement for both Thai and Myanmar workers without discrimination across the two nationalities, the translator and his brother. 
Visitor regulation
Workers also want to know more about receiving visitors. The informant heard that Arkar asks for money from some visitors. It’s not clear why and how much he asks for money. KOTO might want to investigate the case if they are willing.

remediation_issara_recommendation:
Case #1: A worker in a production line for descaling and deboning fish reported that they work as a team of 8, with one descaling while the other 7 debone. The one worker is hard pressed and overburdened to descale the fish in time for the other 7 workers to debone the fish. When the de-scaler reports this to the line supervisor, the supervisor just noted they need to do as they are told and if not then they shouldn't work. She also shouted at the workers when they couldn't de-scale the fish fast enough. One time, one de-scaling worker reported to her about the work overload and was given a warning for that. And the worker was warned that if she complains again, she will be sent to another TUM plant. 

Recommendations:
- Investigate this matter, with worker safeguards and ensuring there is no retaliation against workers.
- Based on the investigation result, take disciplinary action against the line supervisor as per the company's disciplinary policy.  
- Based on the investigation result, revoke the warning that was issued to the worker that had provided feedback to the supervisor about being overloaded.
- Re-train line supervisors on appropriate ways of communication with workers and ensure they understand what is inappropriate and abusive communication / behavior towards workers.


Case #2: The workers reported that the supervisor is biased when it comes to leave approval. She only approves the sick leave or annual leave to the workers who get along with her and butter her up. Those workers do not need to present a medical certificate at all when taking sick leave. For the workers who did not get along with her, they need to present a medical certificate only for half a day or one day. When they request the annual leave, the supervisor asks them to move to another day and not give approval easily. 

Recommendations:
- Investigate this matter, with worker safeguards and ensuring there is no retaliation against workers.
- Based on the investigation result, take disciplinary action against the line supervisor as per the company's disciplinary policy.  
- Re-train line supervisors on fair and objective treatment of workers, and not to show as bias or favoritism to certain workers

call_details.description:
The worker said at Chinsoun production related to the toilet issue, the workers still line up to use the toilets because there are still 5 toilet rooms for men. However, that's fine if the workers just pee because there is a separate place for pee and it is not crowded. 
Alternatively, if the workers want to use the toilet rooms they can go upstairs to use the toilets at another production but it takes about 10 minutes to walk back and forth. o&e update to the worker about the business response that the new toilet construction will be finished in November 2023. The worker said it is fine, the workers just need to line up a bit or go to another toilet till the new toilet finishes and worker also confirm that even worker take some times to go to toilet, now the supervisor quite understandable; there is no pressure or scolding to the workers.

closed_notes: Issara is closing this case. The workers confirmed that they can use other toilets that are further away but are not penalized for taking longer toilet breaks.  The business is constructing additional toilets but will be completed in November 2023.
remediation_issara_recommendation:
Workers in the “chin suon” line reported that there are insufficient toilets in the men's restroom. During the toilet break, there are around 1,000 men that may need to use the restroom, but there are only 6 toilets which is not enough for workers that have 15 minutes for the break.

TPs:
-How many men's restrooms are there for chin suon line workers to use?  How many toilets (urinals and toilet stalls) are available?
-Are workers only allowed to use the toilet during set toilet break times, which could cause traffic jams and long queues to use the toilet?

Recommendations for remediation:
-Assess the number of toilets available for the number of workers, and the times when workers are allowed to use the toilet so that there are sufficient facilities for the number of workers
-Increase the toilet facilities or adjust the schedule for taking toilet breaks so that workers are not wasting too much time waiting in line to use the toilet
remediation_business_steps_taken: The factory is expanding the number of bathrooms that are currently under construction.
remediation_notes: Workers in the “chin suon” line reported that there are insufficient toilets in the men's restroom. During the toilet break, there are around 1,000 men that may need to use the restroom, but there are only 6 toilets which is not enough for workers that have 15 minutes for the break.
remediation_action: The factory replied that it was constructing additional toilets to expand the capacity and lessen congestion. In the latest update from the business, HR noted that the new toilet construction will be completed in November 2023. HR will send a report with proposed short-term arrangements to solve the toilet congestion issue while waiting for the toilet construction to top management.
remediation_validation:
Workers provided an update saying that the new toilets have not been completed and opened for use and no temporary toilets had been set up in the interim either so the long waiting times to use the toilet persisted.  Some workers were even concerned that they might be penalized and not allowed to work OT for coming back late from their toilet breaks.

In the latest update, workers said workers still line up to use the toilets but they can use other toilets upstairs which takes about 10 minutes to walk get to and back.  Even if the workers take longer for toilet breaks, now the supervisors are understanding and there is no pressure or scolding to the workers.  

Issara explained to the worker that the business will complete the new toilet construction in November 2023.
remediation_results: Issara is closing this case. The workers confirmed that they can use other toilets that are further away but are not penalized for taking longer toilet breaks.  The business is constructing additional toilets but will be completed in November 2023.

remediation_issara_recommendation:
A pregnant worker from TUM Building 2 reported that 15 pregnant workers from fish peeling Line 1-9 currently working on the ground floor are facing difficulties with using the toilet. The business announced on 5 June 2023 that workers are not allowed to use toilets on the ground floor anymore and must use toilets on the third floor. Although using toilets on the 3rd floor is not a major challenge for normal workers, it is challenging for pregnant workers especially those who are 6-8 months pregnant. When some pregnant workers checked why this was the case with the red-cap supervisor, the supervisor explained that some visitors don't like workers using the toilets on the ground floor, so the business doesn't allow the day-shift workers to use ground floor toilets. In this situation the pregnant workers would like to request to open one ground floor toilet only for pregnant workers or else provide the chairs on the second floor so they can sit and rest while they go up and down the stairs.

TPs:
- What is the capacity in building 2, and how many people work there?  Are there toilets on all floors?  How many toilet stalls for men and women on each floor?
- What is the reason for requiring all workers to use the toilets on the third floor only?

Recommendations:
- The business should ensure that workers, including pregnant workers, have convenient access to toilets.
remediation_business_steps_taken:
They will investigate this case and get back to us within 7 days.


K. TUM allows pregnant employees to use the first-floor restrooms.

Recommendations.

Time frame 1 week.

-Please ask the business about seats that are provided for workers at their working lines and what arrangement are available for workers to use those seats while working and taking a break? 

-Share with the business that long hours of work in standing position can create health issues with the workers.

-Share with the business that the workers from this building have been standing 
 for the 8 hours of regular work and up to 4 hours of OT work.

-Why is the workers being set up to work by standing up for the whole day? 

-Please ask to the business why the some lines are being provided the chairs while some of them are not being provided?

28-Sep-2020

The business did the announcement to the workers to approach the HR to request seats as they need.

closed_notes: Issara is closing this case because the worker understands the product safety guidelines and the materials being used in the production process meet quality standards. The business interviewed workers during the investigation to get their direct feedback.
remediation_issara_recommendation:
A worker reported that a chief line supervisor (P Nway) asked the workers to use leftover starch powder that is used as batter for fried shrimp (tempura) in Oct 2022. It happened to the specific production at that time but is not happening anymore. The leftover starch powder which has turned hard P Nway collected and ground up to make it powdery again so that it can be used again. According to the worker, the texture of the powder is not the same as the original and it is difficult to create the shape of the food as desired.  Some of the food products coming off this line has been rejected at the quality control stage, and line supervisors were called for a meeting and investigated. According to the worker, those line supervisors may have shifted the blame onto the workers. The workers suggested that they should be invited for the discussion separately so that they can explain to the management what actually happened. They want to let the business know what is happening on the production line. 

P Skee often asks the workers to use leftover food ingredients which are not in good condition or quality. When there's a Chief supervisor, she wouldn't ask the workers to do so. But when the chief supervisor is not around, P Skee would ask the workers to quickly use those leftover ingredients. She would target and ask the workers to help out at other different lines if they talk back to her. And the worker said some batches of food were rejected as they didn't pass the Quality control.  Also, P Skee did not listen to the workers. In one incident, there was a small shrimp among the big shrimp in the package (all the shrimp should be the same size in the package), and the worker showed it to him and pointed out it should be checked and he should alert the other workers to be more careful. P Skee didn’t listen to the worker and let the production continue as if everything was fine. Because he doesn’t supervise the workers well, the workers are becoming more reckless and careless at work. The worker wants to let the business know about it. 

TPs:
-Does the company welcome feedback and suggestions for performance and quality improvement, no matter the level of the employee?  How can workers report concerns they might have about the quality of the products?
-Is HR aware that line workers have seen bad quality work that was overlooked by line supervisors, sometimes even after it was pointed out to the supervisor? 

Recommendations for remediation:
-Regarding the October incident with P Nway, were the line workers included in the investigation?  Conduct follow-up interviews with the workers, which could be very helpful to TUF, given that the workers have concerns about how the supervisor was having workers use bad quality ingredients.  Ensure worker safeguards according to TU's non-retaliation policy
-Announce to all workers how they can safely report any concerns about the quality of the products they are involved in producing.
remediation_business_steps_taken:
Root Cause:
From investigation, The following facts were found:
1. Fried product production line pays attention to product safety and quality including the safety of workers. Because oil is used in frying, and various tools work in the production line which must comply with strict regulations
2. According to product quality control, the use of flour, can be reused within the specified period according to the production quality standards and there are random checks to ensure the quality control of the products in the production process, including requiring workers to strictly comply with hygiene requirements, such as washing hands every time during the washing cycle, and changing work equipment when it's time to change, including GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) regulations, etc.
3. Khun Nui, the department manager, including the QC team, had a meeting with workers. and translate through an interpreter. To remind the various requirements that workers must comply with both preventively as well

Corrective Action:
HR trained the supervisors on how to listen to workers' opinions. Including providing information explaining quality standards, specifications, and methods for checking the quality of flour used to meet the standards for workers to have the same understanding.
If workers still have questions, they can ask the supervisors to clarify such doubts clearly

remediation_results: Issara is closing this case because the worker understands the product safety guidelines and the materials being used in the production process meet quality standards. The business interviewed workers during the investigation to get their direct feedback.

call_details.description: The translator force workers to do MOU without the knowledge of HR. More detail in tracker.

Informant being targeted
This informant is the daughter of ex-informant who left KOTO already. She said that her mother was targeted by Akar, the bad translator, for being an informant to Issara. That’s why she has a huge concern being an informant to us. She doesn’t want to end up with the situation like her mother did. This is one of the main reasons Issara has not been receiving as much worker voice as it should. It would be great if Business must ensure the safe guard for the worker is one of the COCs required by the Buyer. 
Sick Leave
Workers are being barred from getting OT for 6 days, if they take sick leave. For example: a worker gets sick during work. And she meets the nurse at the clinic inside the factory compound. The worker would be asked to stop doing OT for a week. For the workers who take sick leave a day or two also would be asked to stop doing OT for a week. It would be great if KOTO can clarify how OTs are being provided to the workers. 
Foul smell
Workers are unable to sleep well due to the foul smell from the sewage pools near the housing. It smells worse when receiving raw shrimps. Closing all the windows and doors doesn’t help. Issara team had such experience, getting the foul smell, during the housing visit last year. 
Clinic
Workers claim that the clinic provide the same medicine most of the time. A worker, patient, wanted to measure blood pressure to check if the blood pressure is normal. The patient doesn’t know how to speak Thai. So he pointed his finger to sphygmomanometer, hoping the nurse would understand what he wants her to do. Unfortunately, the nurse couldn’t understand what he was trying to say. And he left the clinic without knowing her blood pressure. Although there is a translated chart for basic sickness, the clinic still need an interpreter to provide comprehensive service to the patients. 
 
Housings
This is an old issue which has not been solved yet. Some workers went back to Myanmar as they are not comfortable with the current housing arrangement. 4 to 8 workers, including married couples, sharing the same room while it is not the case for Thai workers. Workers have to pay for water and electric city bill. Both Thai and Myanmar workers don’t have to pay for the room. The informant said, Akar, the translator is sharing his room with his wife only. Even Akar’s brother is allowed to share the room with his wife. KOTO may want to clarify the housing arrangement for both Thai and Myanmar workers without discrimination across the two nationalities, the translator and his brother. 
Visitor regulation
Workers also want to know more about receiving visitors. The informant heard that Arkar asks for money from some visitors. It’s not clear why and how much he asks for money. KOTO might want to investigate the case if they are willing.
